topic: 基础综合复测与薄弱项整理
grammarFocus: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习。
title: The Community Library's New Opening Hours
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。短文是关于一个社区图书馆更改开放时间的通知。请仔细阅读，然后完成单选题、填空题和判断题。所有题目答案均可在文中找到依据。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
The Westside Community Library has changed its opening hours. Last month, the library manager, Sarah, asked people in the neighborhood what times they wanted to use the library. Many people said they needed to study in the evening after work. Some parents said they wanted to bring their children on weekend mornings. So, starting from next Monday, the library will open at 9 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. from Monday to Friday. On Saturdays, it will open at 10 a.m. and close at 4 p.m. The library will be closed on Sundays.

Sarah also said that the library will have a new quiet study room. This room is on the second floor. It has ten desks and free Wi-Fi. People can borrow a key from the front desk. They must return the key before they leave. The library will also start a free English conversation club. The club will meet every Wednesday at 6 p.m. in the meeting room on the first floor. Anyone can join, but they need to sign up at the front desk first.

Many people are happy about the changes. One student, Tom, said, "I work during the day, so I could never come before. Now I can study here in the evening." A mother, Lisa, said, "My children love books. We will come on Saturday mornings." However, not everyone is happy. An old man, Mr. Brown, said, "I liked the old hours. I used to come on Sunday afternoons. Now the library is closed on Sundays. I will miss it." Sarah explained, "We are sorry for the inconvenience, but we must follow the survey results. Most people wanted these new hours." The library will also have a small café next to the front desk. It will sell coffee and sandwiches from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. every day except Sunday.

questions.prompt: What time does the library close from Monday to Friday?
questions.explanation: 文中明确说“the library will open at 9 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. from Monday to Friday”，所以周一到周五闭馆时间是晚上8点。
questions.evidence: the library will open at 9 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. from Monday to Friday

questions.prompt: On which day is the library closed?
questions.explanation: 文中说“The library will be closed on Sundays.”，所以图书馆周日闭馆。
questions.evidence: The library will be closed on Sundays.

questions.prompt: Where is the new quiet study room?
questions.explanation: 文中提到“This room is on the second floor.”，指的就是新的安静学习室。
questions.evidence: This room is on the second floor.

questions.prompt: What must people do before they leave the quiet study room?
options: Sign up at the front desk
questions.explanation: 文中说“They must return the key before they leave.”，所以离开前必须归还钥匙。
questions.evidence: They must return the key before they leave.

questions.prompt: When does the English conversation club meet?
questions.explanation: 文中明确说“The club will meet every Wednesday at 6 p.m.”，所以英语会话俱乐部每周三下午6点活动。
questions.evidence: The club will meet every Wednesday at 6 p.m.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The library will also start a free English ______ club.
questions.explanation: 文中提到“The library will also start a free English conversation club.”，所以填conversation。
questions.evidence: The library will also start a free English conversation club.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The café will sell coffee and sandwiches from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. every day except ______.
questions.explanation: 文中说“It will sell coffee and sandwiches from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. every day except Sunday.”，所以填Sunday。
questions.evidence: It will sell coffee and sandwiches from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. every day except Sunday.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Tom works during the day.
questions.explanation: 文中Tom说“I work during the day”，所以这个陈述是正确的。

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Mr. Brown is happy about the new hours.
questions.explanation: 文中说“However, not everyone is happy. An old man, Mr. Brown, said, 'I liked the old hours... I will miss it.'”，表明Brown先生不满意新时间，所以陈述错误。
questions.evidence: However, not everyone is happy. An old man, Mr. Brown, said, "I liked the old hours. I used to come on Sunday afternoons. Now the library is closed on Sundays. I will miss it."

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: The library will have more books next month.
questions.explanation: 文中没有提到图书馆下个月会增加书籍。文章只说了开放时间、学习室、俱乐部和咖啡馆，没有关于书籍数量的信息，所以是Not Given。
questions.evidence: 文中没有提到图书馆下个月会增加书籍。

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 本部分复习一般现在时、一般过去时、一般将来时、特殊疑问句、名词单复数以及宾语从句和定语从句的基本用法。请根据句子意思选择正确的形式。
grammar.example: The library will open at 9 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. from Monday to Friday.

options: She go to the library every day.
She goes to the library every day.
She going to the library every day.
answers: She goes to the library every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数she时，动词go要加-es，变成goes。
questions.evidence: She goes to the library every day.

options: What time does the library open?
What time do the library open?
answers: What time does the library open?
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构为“疑问词 + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形”。主语the library是第三人称单数，助动词用does，动词用原形open。
questions.evidence: What time does the library open?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct noun form: There are ten ______ in the study room.
questions.explanation: ten后面接可数名词复数，desk的复数是desks。
questions.evidence: There are ten desks in the study room.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a clause:
options: I think that the new hours are good.
I think that are the new hours good.
I think the new hours are good that.
answers: I think that the new hours are good.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用that引导，后面接完整句子，语序为陈述句语序。
questions.evidence: I think that the new hours are good.
